Standard TN Reference

Standard Target Numbers use:

Standard TN = (8 × Challenge MR) − 2

Challenge MR Standard TN One Raise (+4)
MR 1 6 10
MR 2 14 18
MR 3 22 26
MR 4 30 34
MR 5 38 42
MR 6 46 50
MR 7 54 58
MR 8 62 66

The compressed scale keeps physical dice pools manageable while preserving visible progression between Attribute values. Raises remain +4.

Appendix — Special Descriptions

This appendix contains the full wording for Special Effects.

The table in the main rules section is the quick reference. The entries below are the detailed rules text.

Blight(X)

Type: Timed (X Turns)

Stacking: No. Reapplying Blight refreshes its remaining duration to the higher of the current remaining duration and the newly applied X.

Cleanse: Yes

Effect: Blight represents disease, corruption, or pestilence. While affected by Blight, roll every Attribute-based dice pool with Disadvantage. Blight changes neither Dice Pool nor Keep, and it does not reduce Healing Dice, Cleanse, Armor, Speed, or damage by itself.

Duration: X is the number of the affected creature's Turns remaining. Blight takes effect immediately when applied. At the end of each affected creature's Turn, reduce its remaining duration by 1. At 0, Blight ends. Reapplication does not add durations; keep the higher remaining value. Blight does not use Natural Special Recovery, because it is Timed rather than Diminishing. Cleanse may reduce its remaining duration as an eligible negative Special.

Disadvantage reminder: Under the Core Disadvantage rule, one eligible die may explode (normally an 8, or a 7–8 on a designated Critical roll). Blight uses that same Disadvantage rule.

Challenge(X)

Type: Diminishing (X→0)

Stacking: Same source only

Cleanse: Yes

Effect: Challenge represents pressure, provocation, pursuit, protective positioning, or a threat that is difficult to ignore. When Challenge is applied, record the creature that applied it as the challenger.

Whenever you build an Attack Pool for an attack that does not include the challenger as a target, remove X dice from that pool. If the attack includes the challenger as one of its targets, Challenge does not reduce that Attack Pool. Challenge never forces you to attack, move toward, or remain near the challenger.

Challenge reduces Attack Pools only. It does not reduce Attributes, Keep, Damage Pools, Evade, non-attack Attribute Checks, or other derived values. Apply Challenge with other flat pool changes before the percentage-based Health Penalty. The final Attack Pool can reach 0 dice, which fails automatically.

A creature can have only one challenger at a time. Reapplying Challenge from the same challenger adds stacks normally. Challenge from a different source does not add to the existing value; it replaces the current Challenge only if the newly applied value is higher.

At the start of your turn, Challenge decays by 1. If Challenge reaches 0, it ends.

Corrode(X)

Type: Diminishing (X→0)

Stacking: Yes

Cleanse: Yes

Effect: Corrode breaks, melts, cracks, weakens, or bypasses defensive material. Your Armor is reduced by X, including for the hit that just applied Corrode, since the hit's Special resolves before Armor. At the start of your turn, Corrode decays by 1. If Corrode reaches 0, it ends.

Disoriented(X)

Type: Diminishing (X→0)

Stacking: Yes

Cleanse: Yes

Effect: Disoriented represents confusion, blindness, sensory disruption, unstable footing, shock, smoke, noise, or broken focus. Your Attack Dice are reduced by X (minimum 0 dice). All dice pools used to notice, locate, track, or identify something are also reduced by X (minimum 0 dice). At the start of your turn, Disoriented decays by 1. If Disoriented reaches 0, it ends.

Expose(X)

Type: Diminishing (X→0)

Stacking: Yes

Cleanse: Yes

Effect: Expose makes a target easier to hit. Your Evade is reduced by X. At the start of your turn, Expose decays by 1. If Expose reaches 0, it ends.

Hex(X)

Type: Diminishing (X→0)

Stacking: Yes

Cleanse: Yes

Effect: Hex makes a target vulnerable to Spell damage.

When you are hit by a Spell, take +1d8 bonus damage for every 2 Hex already present before that hit, rounded up. Hex applied by the hit contributes starting with the next eligible hit. At the start of your turn, Hex decays by 1. If Hex reaches 0, it ends.

Lacerate(X)

Type: Diminishing (X→0)

Stacking: Yes

Cleanse: Yes

Effect: Each separate Movement Event that changes your position deals X damage once. This includes ordinary Movement, Dash, Reposition, forced Push/Pull, and Teleport. One continuous path is one Movement Event regardless of distance or the number of Hexes crossed. Two distinct movements are two events. Resolve Lacerate damage when the movement event occurs.

At the start of your turn, Lacerate decays by 1. If Lacerate reaches 0, it ends.

Mark(X)

Type: Diminishing (X→0)

Stacking: Yes

Cleanse: Yes

Effect: Mark represents aim, pursuit, target lock, exposed movement, and precise battlefield focus. Mark is tracked as one global counter on the target. A Mark application becomes available after its delivering hit finishes. On a later hit, after its Damage Dice are rolled and before a Damage-Trigger Reaction is resolved, the attacking creature may spend any amount of Mark that was present on the target before that later hit. The amount of Mark spent becomes the Damage Floor for that damage roll. Each damage die that rolled lower than the spent Mark value is treated as if it had rolled that value. Damage dice that rolled equal to or higher than the spent Mark value remain unchanged. After the damage roll is adjusted, reduce Mark by the amount spent. If Mark is reduced to 0, it is removed. At the start of your turn, Mark decays by 1.

Limits: Mark affects damage dice only.

Example: A target has Mark(12).

An attacker hits the target and rolls damage: 1, 1, 1, 2, 5, 7, 8

The attacker spends 5 Mark. All damage dice lower than 5 become 5.

The adjusted damage roll becomes: 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 7, 8

The target's Mark is reduced from Mark(12) to Mark(7).

Root(X)

Type: Until Broken

Stacking: Yes

Cleanse: Yes

Effect: Root is a movement-lock Special. Root can only be applied with a minimum value of Root(2). Root(1) cannot be applied as a valid Root effect.

While Root is above 0, your Speed is 0 m and you cannot move voluntarily. Root does not prevent attacking, casting, using Reactions, or being moved by forced movement. You cannot use Movement Powers to leave your current space while Root remains above 0.

At the start of your Turn, reduce Root by your Mastery Rank. If Root reaches 0, it ends.

Root does not receive Natural Special Recovery and does not use normal Diminishing Decay.

All active Root contributions form one shared Root(X) stack. Record the highest Mastery Rank of any source that contributed to this currently active stack. This recorded MR determines the single break TN, including after natural reduction, until Root reaches 0; then clear both Root and the recorded source MR. For example, MR2 applies Root(3) and MR4 adds Root(5): Root(8), with break TN 30.

You may also spend 1 Attack Action or 1 Movement to make a Vitality Attribute Check against:

TN = (8 × highest recorded Root source Mastery Rank) − 2

On a success, reduce Root by exactly 1. The amount does not increase with the result above TN.

If Root reaches 0, it ends.

Ruin(X)

Type: Diminishing (X→0)

Stacking: Yes

Cleanse: Yes

Effect: Ruin deals ongoing damage. At Tick, take X damage. Ruin damage ignores Armor unless a rule says otherwise. At the start of your turn, after the Tick, Ruin decays by 1. If Ruin reaches 0, it ends.

Slow(X)

Type: Diminishing (X→0)

Stacking: Yes

Cleanse: Yes

Effect: Each point of Slow(X) reduces your Speed by 1 m, to a minimum of 0 m. At the start of your Turn, before Natural Special Recovery and decay, if your Speed is 0 m or another effect prevents you from moving voluntarily (such as Root or Brace), take X damage, ignoring Armor like Ruin.

If you are still able to move voluntarily, Slow deals no damage. Choosing not to move or having already spent your available Movement does not count as being unable to move.

Slow deals no immediate damage when applied. Damage occurs only at the regular start-of-Turn Tick.

After the Tick, apply Natural Special Recovery and reduce Slow by 1. At 0, Slow ends.

Example: A creature with 10 m Speed and Slow(5) has 5 m Speed and takes 0 damage. With Slow(10), its Speed becomes 0 m and it takes 10 damage at Tick. If the creature has Slow(5) and is also affected by Root, it cannot move voluntarily and therefore takes 5 damage at Tick, even though Slow alone would leave it with 5 m Speed. The values in this example assume no recovery between applications.

Soulburn(X)

Type: Diminishing (X→0)

Stacking: Yes

Cleanse: Yes

Effect: Soulburn erodes instinct, presence, will, and spiritual stability. Whenever you build a dice pool based on Wits, Influence, or Resolve, remove X dice from that pool.

Soulburn reduces dice pools, not the Attributes themselves. It does not reduce Keep, Damage Pools, derived values, resource maximums, Health Bars, or other fixed values created from those Attributes.

Apply Soulburn before percentage-based Health Penalties. The final Pool can reach 0 dice, which fails automatically. At the start of your turn, Soulburn decays by 1. If Soulburn reaches 0, it ends.

Sundered(X)

Type: Diminishing (X→0)

Stacking: Yes

Cleanse: Yes

Effect: Sundered makes a target vulnerable to non-Spell attacks. When you are hit by a non-Spell attack, take +1d8 bonus damage for every 2 Sundered already present before that hit, rounded up. Sundered applied by the hit contributes starting with the next eligible hit. At the start of your turn, Sundered decays by 1. If Sundered reaches 0, it ends.

Weaken(X)

Type: Diminishing (X→0)

Stacking: Yes

Cleanse: Yes

Effect: Weaken suppresses physical force, coordination, and structured thought. Whenever you build a dice pool based on Might, Agility, or Intellect, remove X dice from that pool.

Weaken reduces dice pools, not the Attributes themselves. It does not reduce Keep, Damage Pools, derived values, resource maximums, Health Bars, or other fixed values created from those Attributes.

Apply Weaken before percentage-based Health Penalties. The final Pool can reach 0 dice, which fails automatically. At the start of your turn, Weaken decays by 1. If Weaken reaches 0, it ends.

Timed and Fixed Control Special Descriptions

Brace(X)

Type: Timed

Stacking: No

Cleanse: No

Effect: Brace locks you into a defensive stance. Your Speed becomes 0 m. While Braced, your Shield value is doubled for Armor calculation. At the end of each of your turns, reduce Brace by 1. If Brace reaches 0, it ends.

Prone

Type: Until Ended

Duration: Until you stand

Stacking: No

Cleanse: No

Effect: You are knocked down and helpless. While Prone you cannot make attacks, cast Powers, move or use Reactions; your existing Evade and passive defenses still apply. You must stand before doing anything else. Standing spends 1 Attack Action but leaves your Movement available. Prone has no numeric value.

Until Used Special Descriptions

Bulwark(X)

Type: Until Used

Stacking: Yes

Cleanse: No

Effect: Bulwark stores defensive impact protection. As a Reaction when you are hit by an attack you can perceive, reduce the attack’s final damage by 50% and consume 1 Bulwark. If Bulwark reaches 0, it ends.

Immovable

Type: Until Duration Ends

Stacking: No

Cleanse: No

Effect: Only Feet Artifact Base Value B can grant this option. Declare it during the Round's Preparation Phase while allocating Stone Abilities (no separate Action or Stone cost). Until the end of this Round, voluntary Movement is 0 m and forced displacement (Push, Pull, knockback and equivalent effects) fails. Prone and other non-displacement conditions are not automatically prevented; normal Evade and other defenses still apply. Declare it again in each later Round you want to use it.

Instant Special Descriptions

Stunned

Type: Instant

Stacking: No

Cleanse: No

Effect: When Stunned is applied, remove 1 unspent Attack Action from the target's available Attack Actions in the current Round. Resolve the loss immediately; the effect leaves no ongoing Stunned state. If the target has no available Attack Action remaining this Round, there is no Action to remove.

Brutal Impact(X)

Type: Instant

Stacking: No

Cleanse: No

Effect: Brutal Impact creates a minimum damage result for one damage roll. Each damage die rolled counts as at least X. A die that rolls lower than X is treated as if it had rolled X. A die that rolls equal to or higher than X remains unchanged.

Disarm

Type: Instant

Stacking: No

Cleanse: No

Effect: Disarm forces the target to lose grip on one held item.

If an attack with Disarm hits, the target loses grip on one visible held item. The item falls to the ground.

The attacker chooses the affected item. Disarm can affect a weapon, shield, focus, wand, staff, tool, or other object currently held in the target's hand or grip.

Disarm cannot affect armor, worn Artifacts, rings, amulets, natural weapons, claws, bites, body parts, or items that are not currently held.

Recovering a disarmed item requires 1 Movement or 1 Attack Action. Recovering the item also makes it ready to use again.

If an item is physically attached, magically bound, Echo-bound, enormous, or otherwise impossible to remove, the GM may declare that Disarm has no effect on that item. Any other effects of the attack still apply normally.

Penetration(X)

Type: Instant

Stacking: No

Cleanse: No

Effect: Penetration bypasses Armor for one hit. The attack ignores X Armor. Penetration does not reduce the target's Armor value. Penetration applies only to the attack that has Penetration.

Precision(X)

Type: Instant

Stacking: No

Cleanse: No

Effect: Precision adds damage to a successful hit. On hit, add +Xd8 bonus damage.

Push(X)

Type: Instant

Stacking: No

Cleanse: No

Effect: Push moves the target away immediately by up to X m. The creature applying Push chooses the legal destination and path, moving the target away from the source along legal Hexes. Push is a forced Movement Event. If position changes, Lacerate triggers once.

Pull(X)

Type: Instant

Stacking: No

Cleanse: No

Effect: Pull moves the target closer immediately by up to X m. The creature applying Pull chooses the legal destination and path, moving the target toward the source along legal Hexes. Pull is a forced Movement Event. If position changes, Lacerate triggers once.

Support Special Descriptions

Cleanse(X)

Type: Instant Support

Stacking: No

Cleanse: No

Effect: Choose one creature. Remove up to X total points from one or more ongoing negative Specials affecting that creature that list Cleanse: Yes.

You may distribute the Cleanse value freely between those eligible Specials. If a Special is reduced to 0, it ends.

A single Cleanse(X) can affect only one creature. If the creature has less than X total eligible Special value, any unused Cleanse points are lost.

Cleanse does not affect a Special that lists Cleanse: No, and it does not remove a Power, Spell, Barrier, Wall, Summon, or other effect unless that effect explicitly states that Cleanse can remove it.

Example

A creature is affected by Ruin(3), Slow(2), and Hex(4).

Using Cleanse(6) could:

  • remove Ruin(3) and Slow(2), then reduce Hex(4) to Hex(3),
  • remove Hex(4) and reduce Ruin(3) to Ruin(1),
  • or distribute the 6 points in any other way among those eligible Specials.

The Cleanse value cannot be transferred to another creature.
